import sys, tarfile, tempfile, os
import pandas as pd
from scipy.io import mmread
p=sys.argv[1]
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="spatial_diag_")
with tarfile.open(p,"r:*") as t:
    t.extractall(d)
files=[]
for root,dirs,names in os.walk(d):
    for n in names: files.append(os.path.join(root,n))
def pick(*parts):
    for f in files:
        b=os.path.basename(f)
        if all(x in b for x in parts): return f
    raise RuntimeError("missing "+str(parts))
scf=pick("sc_counts.csv")
mdf=pick("sc_metadata.csv")
mtxf=pick("matrix.mtx")
featf=pick("features.tsv")
barf=pick("barcodes.tsv")
sc=pd.read_csv(scf,index_col=0)
md=pd.read_csv(mdf)
sp=mmread(mtxf)
ft=pd.read_csv(featf,sep="\t",header=None,compression="infer")
bc=pd.read_csv(barf,sep="\t",header=None,compression="infer")
print("FILES",sorted(os.path.basename(x) for x in files))
print("SC_SHAPE",sc.shape,"SC_INDEX_FIRST",list(map(str,sc.index[:3])),"SC_COL_FIRST",list(map(str,sc.columns[:3])))
print("META_SHAPE",md.shape,"META_COLS",list(md.columns))
print("META_HEAD")
print(md.head(3).to_string(index=False))
for c in md.columns:
    if md[c].nunique(dropna=True)<=30:
        print("META_UNIQUE",c,sorted(map(str,md[c].dropna().unique())))
print("SP_SHAPE",sp.shape,"FEATURES",ft.shape,"BARCODES",bc.shape)
print("FEATURE_HEAD")
print(ft.head(3).to_string(index=False,header=False))
print("BARCODE_HEAD",list(map(str,bc.iloc[:5,0])))
target="Spot_710-1"
